production.note: Calendar years, home market (owner decision, 8 October 2026). Toyota Gazoo Racing heritage page heading: 'Toyota 2000GT (1967-1970)', 'Launched in 1967 by Toyota Motor, with the cooperation of Yamaha Motor Co., Ltd.' Conceptcarz: 'Production lasted from May of 1967 until August of 1970' (conceptcarz-2000gt). Yamaha: 'a total of 337 units (including 115 for export) were hand-built' (yamaha-2000gt). Some cars were sold in the US (Conceptcarz: 'approximately 60 examples were sold to North America'); per the owner the US model year was 1968 only. The owner chose the home-market record.

aspiration.note: Conceptcarz: 'Yamaha fitted three two-barrel Mikuni-Solex 40 PHH carburetors'; no forced induction.

drivetrain.note: Conceptcarz: 'sending power to the rear wheels via three different final drives and a limited-slip differential'.

transmission.note: Conceptcarz: 'backed by a five-speed manual transmission'. GearShifters (unsigned) mentions a 2000GT 'with automatic transmission' (MF 10-C); its number of speeds was not found on any page opened, so it is not listed (see reviewNotes).

powerHp.note: Quote (Yamaha Motor, which developed and built the car for Toyota): "Maximum power output: 110.3kW (150.0PS) / 6,600r/min". 150 PS x 0.98632 = 147.9, rounded to 148 hp (owner decision, 8 October 2026; fastestlaps also gives 148). This is a period Japanese gross rating, so powerStandard is 'Other' per the classic-car rule. Conceptcarz also gives '148 horsepower at 6,600 RPM'.

weightLb.note: Manufacturer figure (owner decision, 8 October 2026). Quote (Yamaha): "Weight: 1,120kg" (Japanese page: '重量: 1,120kg'). 1,120 x 2.20462 = 2,469.2, rounded to 2,469 lb. Yamaha's label is plain 'Weight'; per the owner, JAF Mate labels the same figure vehicle weight (車両重量, the Japanese kerb weight); the JAF Mate page was not reopened in this pass. Yamaha says its figures are 'from when the model was originally released' (1967). Conceptcarz's '2,500-pound car' is a round figure in body text and is not used.

sources.publisher: Yamaha Motor (built the car for Toyota)
sources.title: 1967 TOYOTA 2000GT (Yamaha Communication Plaza collection)

reviewNotes: Transmission: a 2000GT with an automatic transmission (MF10-C?) is mentioned only by an unsigned page (GearShifters) and its number of speeds was not found, so only the 5-speed manual is listed; add the automatic if a Toyota/Yamaha or magazine source confirms it. Weight: Yamaha labels 1,120 kg plain 'Weight'; it is used as a kerb weight on the owner decision, 8 October 2026 (JAF Mate calls it vehicle weight).
